definition: a church with a monastery beside it
description: A laughing young woman in a yellow raincoat, a striped top, rolled jeans and a straw hat rides a bicycle along a wet stone causeway, holding her hat on with one hand. Her wheels splash through sea water as she rides, and waves break on both sides. Behind her a big old grey stone abbey church with a tall square bell tower, arched windows and slate roofs stands on a rocky island with a green walled garden. Gulls fly under a heavy grey sky.
